title: Please add Portuguese
body: Could you please add Portuguese or an option to change the app language? I couldn’t find any language settings, not even Spanish, and I’d really like to try the app.
author: visbsjxnskxj

title: Helpful, but the notifications are annoying
body: I’m only interested in routine reminders, please let me turn off the stuff that pops up in the middle of the afternoon even though my next routine is at the end of the night.
author: D. Campos
